title: Project configuration (.devloops/devloops.json and .devloops/devloops.local.json)
description: Both files share this schema; the local file is deep-merged over the shared one. Relative paths resolve against the project root (the parent of .devloops/).

workspace.description: Default workspace name when --workspace is not given (FR-011)

backend-dev.description: A folder: the project uses backend-dev and it writes there. null or missing: the project does not use backend-dev (003 FR-005)

frontend-dev.description: A folder: the project uses frontend-dev and it writes there. null or missing: the project does not use frontend-dev (003 FR-005)

targets.description: Default loop targets (FR-011, FR-013); which loops `devloops run` runs (003 FR-005)

requirements.description: Default requirements input (FR-011, FR-023, FR-024). Exactly one of path / speckit_feature (checked in code: the stdlib validator has no oneOf); story_file only with path.

speckit_feature.description: A spec-kit feature folder, or "active" for the feature in .specify/feature.json

config.description: Run configuration overrides; same shape as 001's config.json (layers 2 and 3 of research P-4)
